layers.source: External local and GitHub repositories and files. Never silently mutated by discovery.
layers.raw_observation: Append-only scan, research, lesson, handoff, and audit evidence.
layers.processed_catalog: Regenerable normalized asset records, graph edges, scores, alerts, and context packs.
layers.governance: Repo-local schemas, registries, workflow gates, and promotion rules.
layers.curated_export: Human-reviewed exports suitable for reuse outside the generated catalog.

authority_rule: Scanned repositories retain authority over their own internal meaning and canon.
promotion_rule: Generated candidates do not become reviewed or baseline assets without explicit promotion evidence.
